amendment_rule: Never edit this file. A change is a NEW file (p4a-2.json) stating the defect, rationale, changed estimand or procedure, and whether the resulting analysis is exploratory or confirmatory.

protocol.interpretation_rule: voice adds measurable information ONLY IF the 95% cluster-bootstrap interval of AUC(FULL) - AUC(reference) excludes 0 for every reference set AND the effect is reproduced for every seed; otherwise the data cannot show that it does. Neither outcome is evidence of clinical usefulness.

risk.target: total_UPDRS(t) - total_UPDRS(first visit) >= threshold, concurrent, row-level
